title: Semver parse/compare with correct prerelease precedence
requirements: parse('1.2.3-rc.1') returns (1, 2, 3, ('rc', 1)) with numeric prerelease identifiers as ints and () when there is none; invalid versions raise ValueError

compare(a, b) returns -1/0/1 by semver precedence: a prerelease sorts before its release, numeric identifiers compare numerically and before alphanumeric ones, and a shorter prerelease sorts first when the rest is equal
(after the user switch) bump(v, 'major'|'minor'|'patch') returns the next version, dropping any prerelease and zeroing lower parts
user_messages: semver.parse and semver.compare. parse('1.2.3-rc.1') → (1, 2, 3, ('rc', 1)), numbers in the prerelease as ints, empty tuple if no prerelease, garbage → ValueError
compare(a, b) → -1/0/1 using real semver precedence: 1.0.0-alpha < 1.0.0, numeric ids compare as numbers (beta.2 < beta.11) and come before text ids, and alpha < alpha.1
can you add bump(v, part) too? major/minor/patch, and it should drop the -rc stuff
